questionSnapshot.question: In Coco, what holiday is the film centered around?
answers: Día de los Muertos (Day of the Dead)

notes: Read all four options, full matching topic digests and cross-bank comparisons; checked wording, category, editorial difficulty and main-film scope. Challenged Halloween because both involve skeleton imagery. The film’s ofrenda/bridge rules and cemetery celebration explicitly center Day of the Dead, not Halloween, Christmas or Three Kings Day. The question concerns the central holiday, not a claim that characters never celebrate another holiday.
